byo_ai_onboarding.mission: Learn compositional analysis with Hs — a deterministic EXTENSION to standard CoDa — well enough to run it and read its outputs. Bring your own AI; this node + the chain teach it.
byo_ai_onboarding.the_one_idea: A composition carries only relative information; Hs reads its DYNAMICS in Aitchison log-ratio geometry, deterministically, with a hash receipt. 4 parts = an exact quaternion rotation; higher-D is tiled from overlapping exact 4-part charts and reconstructed losslessly.
byo_ai_onboarding.standard_coda_relation: Hs uses STANDARD CoDa tools (closure, CLR, ILR/Helmert, the Aitchison metric) — the same geometry the CoDa community uses — and extends them into a deterministic monitoring instrument for machine and embedded applications. The mathematics is standard CoDa-compatible; the deterministic instrument is the new part.
byo_ai_onboarding.determinism_doctrine: Determinism is binding by doctrine AND practice: same input -> same output -> same content hash, on any machine, no statistics in the science path. See ../HUF/huf-gov/doctrine/.
byo_ai_onboarding.expert_decides: The instrument reads and hands you diagnostics (helmsman, K_eff, regime, internal/external fault); the domain expert assigns meaning. Open-loop (Skydiver Doctrine).
